name: Filter Slot
description: A slot that picks which items pass or which recipe runs.

pages.title: Filter Slot
pages.text:
A **filter slot** is a small slot on the face of a brass funnel, tunnel, Smart Chute and many machines. Put an item or a filter in it to choose what passes.\
\
A List Filter matches chosen items; an Attribute Filter matches by property. On a machine where two recipes fit, an item in its filter slot picks one.
